`interface ITextGlyph`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`TextGlyph`](/reference/text/textglyph/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.effect` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITextGlyph.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/effect/ITextGlyph.java)

One laid-out glyph as an `ITextEffect` sees it, with its place, its metrics in design pixels, and the codepoint, color and offset an effect can change.

## Description

Positions and metrics are in design pixels, scaled by the font size of the glyph.

## Learn more

- [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/)

<a id="ITextGlyph-properties"></a>

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [codepoint](#ITextGlyph-property-codepoint) | `int` |  | The character that the glyph draws: `getCodepoint()` reads it, `codepoint(int)` replaces it, for example to scramble a text; the advance of the glyph is unchanged. |
| [color](#ITextGlyph-property-color) | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) |  | The color the glyph draws in: `getColor()` reads it, `color(Color)` replaces it. |
